subject: Post-call: security discovery & questionnaire initiation (SOC2 / GDPR / HIPAA)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@finexhealth.com>, security@finexhealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call: security discovery & questionnaire initiation (SOC2 / GDPR / HIPAA)

Hi Olivia / Finex security team —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier today — appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your SIG/CAIQ kickoff moving: 

Summary of what we heard on the call:
- Finex Health will evaluate Redwood for customer-facing inference (PHI flow through API layer) and needs clarity on data handling and investigational logging.
- Primary compliance concerns: SOC 2 Type II evidence, GDPR data subject controls, and HIPAA applicability for certain integrations.
- Finex prefers a streamlined intake (either CAIQ+ attachments or SIG Lite prefill) rather than a lengthy custom form if possible.

Asks / next steps: 
1) Can you confirm your preferred questionnaire format (CAIQ or SIG Lite) and whether we should attach a prefilled template?
2) Please share the Finex primary security contact for ongoing evidence exchange (name + best email).
3) Can you confirm SOC 2 status (type & last audit date) and whether the report can be shared under NDA?
4) Is there a short list of primary evidence items you need first (e.g., encryption-at-rest policy, key mgmt, IAM matrix, data retention schedule, pen test summary)? If so, list top 3 so we prioritize.
5) Proposed timeline: our team can assemble a prefill + drop the SOC2 and pen test summary in a shared folder by EOD Wednesday (10/7) if you confirm preference and point of contact.

Attached: redwood_sig_prefill_template.xlsx (simple prefill we can customize) — not final, just to accelerate.

If easier, we can set a 30-min handoff with your security lead to walk the artifacts and scope controls. Happy to schedule.

Thanks —
Camila
Camila Reyes | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0129
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@finexhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 15:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: security discovery & questionnaire initiation (SOC2 / GDPR / HIPAA)

Camila — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below and next steps from our side.

1) Questionnaire preference: we prefer the CAIQ (it maps directly to our intake workflow). SIG Lite would also work for a first-pass, but CAIQ + attachments is our usual path.
2) Primary contact: Olivia Park (me) — olivia.park@finexhealth.com; security@finexhealth.com is monitored by our compliance ops.
3) SOC 2: Finex completed SOC 2 Type II (Security & Availability) — report date: 2024-11-15. We can share the SOC 2 under a mutual NDA.
4) Top evidence asks to prioritize (in order):
   - Encryption at rest & in-transit overview + key management owner (pdf or doc)
   - IAM / access control matrix (CSV or exported table)
   - Pen test executive summary (PDF)

We have the SOC2_report_2024.pdf and pen_test_summary_q2_2026.pdf ready. I can put those in a shared folder and grant Redwood access once the NDA is in place.

Timeline: share CAIQ link and we will start the CAIQ prefilling on our side if you send a prefill. If Redwood can provide the prefill by EOD Wednesday (10/7), that works for us and we'll aim to complete our side within 5 business days.

Thanks — speak soon.
Olivia Park
Head of Security & Compliance
Finex Health
olivia.park@finexhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-9844
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@finexhealth.com>, security@finexhealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: security discovery & questionnaire initiation (SOC2 / GDPR / HIPAA)

Perfect — thanks Olivia, that timeline and ask list is helpful. Two clarifications before we assemble the prefill: 

A) Evidence formats: we will attach the SOC2 and pen test summary as PDFs. For the IAM/access matrix — would a CSV export of your RBAC table be ideal, or do you prefer an exported PDF snapshot? We can accept either; CSV helps our mapping automation.

B) HIPAA scope: during the call you mentioned a subset of Finex integrations will touch PHI. To align controls, can you confirm whether the PHI flows are: 1) only to downstream storage owned by Finex, or 2) also passed to vendor processing (i.e., Redwood API layer will see PHI)? This affects our recommended redaction/caching config and whether we need to include our BAA conversation.

C) NDA: we have a mutual NDA template we can route via DocuSign. Should I send to olivia.park@finexhealth.com? Once signed we will drop SOC2_report_2024.pdf and pen_test_summary_q2_2026.pdf into the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/finex/soc2-2024 and invite your security account.

Planned next steps (our side):
- Wed 10/7: deliver prefilled CAIQ (based on attached template) + SOC2 & pen test PDFs to the shared Drive (post-NDA).
- Fri 10/9: propose 30-min artifact walkthrough with your security lead (we'll bring our compliance engineering lead).

If you confirm CSV for IAM and PHI flow answer (option 1 or 2), I'll kick the NDA and drop the docs.

Thanks —
Camila
